name: prereg_pilot_v0
note: Pre-registration for the NEXT stage. Nothing here has been executed. Changing any field after seeing test results invalidates the pilot.

primary_endpoint.metric: group (Winoground group score, strict, 1e-9 tie tolerance)
primary_endpoint.effect: mean over test seeds of [group(hardneg_eq) - group(hardneg)]
primary_endpoint.ci: 95% paired percentile bootstrap over test groups (2000 resamples), each resample averaging the 5 test seeds

decision.INCONCLUSIVE: otherwise (report CI; do not call it 'no effect')

secondary_endpoints.subset: binding_necessary: groups whose op kinds are all in {binding, relation}

narrowing_rules.template: effect on test_heldout_template < 0.5 * effect on test_composition -> claim limited to seen templates
narrowing_rules.metric: SUPPORTED on group but not on match (or vice versa) -> metric-dependent claim
narrowing_rules.axis: effect on test_composition but not on test_heldout_pairs (or vice versa) -> claim limited to that axis
narrowing_rules.architecture: effect confined to disjoint-object compositions -> attribute to the image head's architectural additivity plus the text side
narrowing_rules.artifact: blind detectability WARN, or content-only channel group > chance + 0.05 on same-word binding groups -> fix data before any claim
narrowing_rules.scope: synthetic proxy features only; no claim about natural images or about the frozen encoder itself
narrowing_rules.binding: effect on the binding_necessary subset of test_composition < 0.05 or its CI lower bound <= 0 -> describe the result as edit composition in general, not as binding

tuning.selection_metric: group on dev, mean over tuning seeds
tuning.rationale_lam_grid: smoke_v0 showed the edit-consistency gradient ~80x the task gradient at init with lam_eq=0.3, so the grid extends two decades below 0.3

calibration: pair-level threshold fitted on calib only; never on dev or test

resource_caps.hardware: CPU only (4 cores), no GPU, no downloads, no paid APIs
resource_caps.note: Caps are upper bounds, not spend. Record actual wall/CPU time and peak RSS per run in manifest.json. smoke_v0 measured 5.96 / 6.39 / 6.33 s for 60 steps (inbatch / hardneg / hardneg_eq): single measurements, not a benchmark.

reporting: all runs including failed/OOM/NOT_RUN are kept; no seed selection; tuning seeds are never reported as test results

amendments.change: added binding_necessary subset endpoints and the 'binding' narrowing rule; primary endpoint unchanged
amendments.reason: smoke_v0 (technical run, not a pilot) showed the content-only channel of every variant reaches GroupMatch 0.65-0.76 on full test_composition (chance 0.5), so full-split metrics are partly solvable without binding. No treatment-vs-baseline difference was used for this change.
